Hi everyone,

I have a dataset with all neighbourhoods in a city and a value for each neighbourhood. I would like to be able to find out whether the value of each neighbourhood is significantly higher or lower than the city average across all neighbourhoods.

I am not sure how to test whether the value for each neighbourhood is statistically different from the city value. 

Thank you very much!

Dani-Orchid
